text:
lex: small idea  add a compact 'Cost Snapshot' pill on route rows that shows % token delta vs baseline + a tiny chevron to open modal with sample_count, quick cache-hit estimate, and top model SKUs. good for quick triage.

anna: +1. baseline should be hour-of-day median over last 7d to avoid daily traffic noise. show 'insufficient data' under 40 samples.

mohit: Implementation note: reuse token_telemetry ingest and run a sampler aggregator (1/200) into a metrics table. no new high-card events.

carmen: API: GET /internal/cost-snapshot?route_gv=...&window=1h -> {pct_delta, cache_savings_pct, sample_count, top_models}. restrict to console service account and cache 5m.

lex: UX: pill color scheme green/amber/red, hover shows 15m sparkline + tooltip "estimates from sampled KV hits; noisy for small samples". CSV export only for billing/admin roles.

mohit: Rollout: feature flag + 5% org canary for 72h. telemetry events to monitor: `cost_snapshot_render` and `cost_snapshot_export`. add prom alert if aggregator lag >3m.

ops-bot: ticket created: CONSOLE-3051 "cost-snapshot-pill-and-modal" assigned to mohit,anna,lex.

anna: I'll sketch microcopy and CSV columns tomorrow. thanks :thumbsup:
